description: Add an existing website to this studio so its content can be edited in Tusk. `name` is required; `domain` (the live hostname) and `previewUrl` (an https address Tusk can reach to scan and preview) are strongly recommended so the site is connectable straight away. `deployHook` (an https deploy hook, or a vercel://token@team/project URL) lets a publish rebuild the host. Returns the new site and its slug. Does not build or host a website. May return a 402 if the studio has reached its site limit.

deployHook.description: Deploy hook to rebuild the host on publish (https:// or vercel://token@team/project).

name.description: Human name of the site, e.g. "Suntex".

org.description: Organisation label shown in the dashboard; defaults to the name.

previewUrl.description: An https URL Tusk can fetch to scan/preview, e.g. a Vercel preview.

slug.description: Optional slug override; derived from the name when omitted.

startEmpty.description: Default true: no demo pages or placeholder fields — the scan defines everything. Pass false only to get Tusk's worked-example starter content.

name: create_site
title: Create site
